thread:
Rina M: Quick triage: we need to lock which observable surfaces are in the sprint slice. Focus areas: lightweight dashboards, tracing hook policy, cost breakdown per-customer, and an error analytics prototype. Keep it bite-sized.
Derek H: I can take the dashboard slice. Goal: 4 panels + a CSV export. Panels: traffic, latency (p50/p90), cost by customer, and error-rate heatmap.
Priya S: For tracing hooks Im proposing adaptive sampling: base_sample = 0.05, bump to 0.5 for routes with >1% error spike or cost > $0.5/min. We avoid blanket tiers; this reacts to signals.
Jonas V: Adaptive sounds good but we need per-route override toggles. Also retention tiers: 14d for standard, 180d for enterprise.
Rina M: Cost breakdown method decision: do we attach a cost tag at request time (tokens * model_rate) or compute later in aggregate? Pros/cons?
Derek H: Tagging at ingest gives immediate cost panels and makes exports simple. Downside: increases payload size slightly. We can compress keys to short codes to keep overhead minimal.
Priya S: Agree tag at ingest. Keep tag set tiny: c=cost_usd,t=tokens,m=model. Use microformat: c=0.0074;t=42;m=gpt-large.
Jonas V: Error analytics approach: cluster by normalized trace signature + prompt-hash. UX: show exemplar query + cluster size + avg cost. Acceptance: clusters reduce manual triage time by >40% in our simulation.
Rina M: Launch acceptance checklist draft: 1) 4 dashboard panels live and editable; 2) CSV export for cost slices; 3) adaptive tracing deployed with route overrides; 4) cost tags emitted and visible in UI; 5) error clustering prototype with exemplar links; 6) telemetry governance doc + opt-in template.
Derek H: Perf guardrail: add telemetry must not increase median latency by >10ms or p95 by >1.5%. If breached, sampling threshold auto-raises.
Priya S: Implementation note: trace payload must stay <3KB for sampled traces. We'll drop large prompt bodies and keep prompt-hash only.
Jonas V: For beta customers we have two volunteers: BlueLeaf and BetaPilot. Rina, can you run onboarding checklist with them?
Rina M: Yep, I'll coordinate. Also will draft the governance snippet on PII: remove free-text prompt bodies unless customer opts in.
TelemetryBot: TASK CREATED: OBS-DASH-981 Adaptive sampling + cost-tagged dashboards assigned to Rina M, Derek H, Priya S, Jonas V.
Derek H: Action items: Ill wireframe panels and a CSV export endpoint. ETA: 3 days for wireframe, 1 week for working slice.
Priya S: Ill prototype adaptive sampler and an overrides API. ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow.
Jonas V: Ill spin up clustering prototype and run a small eval on last months errors.
Rina M: Perf tests scheduled in staging Friday. If all green, aim to cut alpha build for BlueLeaf next Tue.
Derek H: Cool. Let's reconvene Monday 15min to confirm tradeoffs.
Rina M: Thanks team :rocket:
